Hymn 102: Jesus, Lover of My Soul
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Joseph Parry
Lyricist/Text Author: Charles Wesley
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 102 titled "Jesus, Lover of My Soul" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph Parry and the lyrics were written by Charles Wesley.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
